description.la: Documenta quinti concilii Lateranensis (1512–1517) sub Iulio II et Leone X, cum bulla Apostolici regiminis de anima.
description.en-US: The documents of the eighteenth ecumenical council, held at the Lateran in 1512–1517 under Julius II and Leo X: the condemnation of the Pragmatic Sanction and of the Pisan conciliabulum, the bull Apostolici regiminis on the immortality of the soul, and the reform decrees. Latin text.
description.pt-BR: Os documentos do décimo oitavo concílio ecumênico, reunido no Latrão em 1512–1517 sob Júlio II e Leão X: a bula Apostolici regiminis sobre a imortalidade da alma e os decretos de reforma.

la.editor: Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962), via Latin Wikisource / Documenta Catholica Omnia

sources.edition: Latin Wikisource, Concilium Lateranense V Documenta, the text of Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962) as circulated by Documenta Catholica Omnia. Wikitext fetched through action=raw.
sources.description: Complete as transcribed. The digitisation has its punctuation largely stripped, no capitals at the start of sentences, lowercase deus/dominus, and no canon numbers; the text is left as transcribed, with line breaks kept as paragraph breaks, the digitisation's split enclitics rejoined and bracketed headings turned into markdown headings. No public-domain English translation of this text has been imported yet.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval documents; the digitisation derives from the Library of Latin Texts / COD text (a critical edition of 1962/1973), which carries at most a neighbouring right that has run out and is freely redistributed by Wikisource and Documenta Catholica Omnia.
